reason: The expanded audit confirmed two recorder-glibc repetition-selection defects and two source-valid 255-byte resource failures. The same corrective slice must add the two missing semantic tests and make the evaluator's state-key, endpoint-selection, and shared-fixture contracts explicit before another audit.

boundary.startingEvent: A valid ASCII POSIX ERE installed by startup MSGTYPE or AUTOPICKUP_EXCEPTION is compiled and matched through the recorder-glibc wrapper contract.
boundary.endingEvent: Compilation returns the recorder diagnostic or installed matching selects the same boolean and MSGTYPE action as glibc within the committed time and memory budgets at the source 255-byte pattern and message limits.
boundary.validInputs: Recorder-glibc REG_EXTENDED|REG_NOSUB ASCII patterns containing zero-minimum and finite nested captures, numeric references, contextual carets, adjacent repeat operators, unanchored wide frontiers, and correlated variable-width retained captures.
boundary.observables: Compile acceptance and diagnostic, match boolean and selected action, installed startup state, complete screens/cursors and PRNG calls, plus wall time and maxRSS for exact 255-byte adversaries.
boundary.exclusions: Non-ASCII C.UTF-8 locale matching, runtime autopickup object filtering, interactive MSGTYPE editing and serialization, USER_SOUNDS, and gameplay after the next message/input boundary remain named before-effect boundaries.

candidateListMethod.upstreamEntryPoints: sys/share/posixregex.c regex_init/regex_match delegates to recorder glibc regcomp/regexec; glibc regcomp/regexec capture selection defines the required semantics; options.c msgtype_parse_add/msgtype_type and add_autopickup_exception are the installed consumers.
candidateListMethod.dispatchTablesAndCatalogs: The parsed ASCII ERE tree, repeat endpoint forms, referenced capture ids, candidate starts, source BUFSZ limits, and committed direct/reference resource budgets define the complete audited families.
candidateListMethod.reachableHelpers: The expanded audit supplied direct libc and live MSGTYPE discriminators for both semantic defects and exact 255-byte formulas for both resource failures; related keying, interval-selection, fixed-point, and runner-fixture paths were clustered by shared ownership.
candidateListMethod.javascriptCrossCheck: Inspect js/posixregex.js parser and direct/reference evaluators, js/options.js installed consumers, and the focused, direct-libc, fresh, and resource runners for duplicated fixtures, candidate-local assumptions, eager frontier materialization, and abort-based guesses.
candidateListMethod.remainingLimits: The list is exhaustive for the nine confirmed audit deferrals. A solution must preserve exact booleans and diagnostics without a state-count abort; named non-ASCII and later consumer boundaries remain excluded.

entries.reachability: A referenced capture is inside an unbounded outer star or {0,} and the input permits more than one outer repetition.
entries.effects: A configured MSGTYPE rule can reject a welcome or ordinary message that recorder glibc matches.
entries.evidence: Recorder libc matches ^(a+)*\1$ and ^(a+){0,}\1$ on aaa and the live ^Hello (a+)*\1, welcome rule; current JavaScript stops the outer repeat after one iteration.
entries.remaining: Restrict the positive-minimum first-submatch selection rule, preserve + controls, and pass direct-libc plus live MSGTYPE cases.

entries.reachability: A finite repeated group first reaches a referenced descendant and later takes a sibling where that descendant does not participate.
entries.effects: Clearing every descendant loses glibc's retained last participating value and changes the final match.
entries.evidence: Recorder libc accepts ^((a)|b){0,2}\2$ on aba while current JavaScript rejects it; existing endpoint cases require clearing only the selected directly repeated capture.
entries.remaining: Implement the source-shaped endpoint rule, retain descendants, and keep both endpoint-selection and nested-retention discriminators.

entries.reachability: Four referenced captures retain several correlated widths through an ambiguous repeat at the exact source pattern and message limits.
entries.effects: Synchronous matching exceeds the 2,000 ms and 128 MiB budget despite agreeing with glibc's boolean.
entries.evidence: The confirmed 255-byte pattern built from ^((a+)|(a+)|(a+)|(a+))*\2\3\4\5, 108 empty groups, and c{235}b$ took about 3.8 seconds/177 MiB versus libc about 31 ms.
entries.remaining: Preserve exact capture correlations with a compact or lazy representation and pass the exact-boundary oracle and resource budget without a guessed abort.

entries.reachability: A valid unanchored pattern exposes a broad endpoint frontier through a long optional sequence and restarts at every candidate input position.
entries.effects: Both matcher kinds exceed committed time budgets, and the direct case exceeds its memory budget.
entries.evidence: Exact 255-byte direct (a|aa)* plus 123 a? and b$ took about 6 seconds/142 MiB; the reference pattern with 124 a? before \1b$ took about 3 seconds, while recorder libc returned the same false results much faster.
entries.remaining: Share only start-independent work, preserve contextual-caret matchStart, avoid repeated frontier materialization, and pass both exact resource cases.

entries.reachability: A reference-bearing pattern consumes a newline before reaching an internal caret and then evaluates a later reference.
entries.effects: Candidate-start provenance can regress while existing reference-aware caret coverage remains negative-only.
entries.evidence: Recorder libc and current JavaScript match (.+^b)(x)\2 on newline+bxx and reject newline+bx; the positive path is absent from persistent tests.
entries.remaining: Add match/miss cases to focused and libc-backed validation and assert reference-aware routing.

entries.reachability: Recorder glibc accepts adjacent repeat operators whose inner node may return its starting position.
entries.effects: A fixed-point regression can synchronously hang while compile-only tests remain green.
entries.evidence: Recorder libc and current JavaScript match ^a**$ and ^a?+$ on empty, a, and aa and reject b; current tests only compile these forms.
entries.remaining: Add match/miss cases under an interruptible process-level timeout rather than relying on node:test's same-process timeout.

entries.reachability: Contextual caret behavior differs for equal position/capture states that originated at different candidate starts.
entries.effects: Future cross-start memoization can merge nonequivalent states because the key and comment omit matchStart.
entries.evidence: Current behavior is safe only because both caches are candidate-local, while the implementation comment claims position plus captures is complete future equivalence.
entries.remaining: Include matchStart in both keys or explicitly enforce and document candidate-local scope; revalidate internal-caret cases.

entries.reachability: A bounded repeated capture passes an intermediate count before the selected recorder-glibc endpoint.
entries.effects: An unexplained broad descendant-clearing loop conceals the confirmed semantic defect and is easy to reintroduce.
entries.evidence: The current condition count > minimum and count < maximum encodes a glibc-specific selection rule without naming its source behavior.
entries.remaining: Express the corrected rule with a named predicate and source-shaped comment beside the implementation and discriminators.

entries.reachability: The direct libc oracle and resource runner are expected to validate the same 255-byte pattern/input pairs.
entries.effects: Independent copies can drift so boolean parity and measured budgets silently cover different adversaries.
entries.evidence: Both runners currently define their own formulas, while only the resource runner asserts exact byte lengths.
entries.remaining: Move formulas to one dependency-free fixture owner imported by both runners; retain byte assertions and runner-specific budgets.

missingWorkByOwner.next: Derive one exact evaluator correction from recorder-glibc selection semantics, add the four red production/resource discriminators, and reject any abort-based or guessed result.
Centralize exact-boundary fixtures, add interruptible semantic controls, then rerun focused, direct-libc, fresh, resource, broad non-mutation, generated/static, development, and exact-head CI gates.

sourceReview: Incomplete until the corrective worker traces glibc zero-minimum versus positive-minimum capture selection and proves the chosen compact state/frontier representation preserves every reference and contextual-caret dependency at the source limits.
